name: omp-warden
description: A configurable model-classifier gate for oh-my-pi (omp) tool calls, layered on omp's native approval.

enabled.description: Turn the classifier gate on or off. When off, omp's native approval decides alone.

debug.description: Print a line to chat for each call checked, including each rule's score and the verdict.

includeContext.description: Send the conversation to the judge so already-authorized calls aren't re-asked.

judgeRole.description: Stage-1 model role (a native judge, e.g. a local tiny model). Empty disables the classifier stage.

llmRole.description: Stage-2 chat model role; falls back to the 'default' role when unset in omp. Empty disables the llm stage.

onNoAnswer.description: What a stage that should answer but cannot falls back to (model down, timeout, or not a judge).
